cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The error message is directly set from user-controlled input (userApp.getAppId() via ui.message interpolation) without proper output encoding, potentially allowing XSS if the message is rendered in HTML.
Similar to the first case, the error message incorporates userApp.getAppId() without encoding, risking XSS when displayed.
The failure message includes userApp.getAppId(), which is user input, and is not neutralized before being stored in the session and later output, leading to XSS vulnerability.
